description: This file defines an Angular component named EditUserModalComponent. It acts as a wrapper for a drawer component that allows editing user details, managing visibility, user data input, and emitting events upon user updates or modal closure.

classes.name: EditUserModalComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying a modal to edit user details, with input properties for visibility and user data, and output events for changes and updates.

methods.name: visible
methods.description: Boolean input to control modal visibility.

methods.name: visibleChange
methods.description: Event emitter for changes in visibility status.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Input property carrying the user data to be edited.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Event emitter triggered when the modal is closed.

methods.name: userUpdated
methods.description: Event emitter triggered when the user information is successfully updated.
